title: Tooling: reject changed-base mixtures in PR file overlap snapshots
body:
## Change and scope

Bind changed-file overlap inventories to **both PR head and base OIDs**. Previously, a two-page response with identical head/count but a changed base was accepted as 200 complete paths. This PR rejects that mocked counterexample, retains both endpoints in cached inventories and exposes base mismatches when joining them to PR metadata—even when no path matches the query.

Legacy caches keep unknown bases unknown. Online path queries refresh only endpoint-incomplete sources; failed/offline refreshes retain evidence with explicit warnings. This is coordination-tool consistency, not an atomic GitHub snapshot, proof of novelty or a mathematical result. No live PR misreport is alleged.

## Task and overlap

Base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, refreshed before selection and publication. Verification engineering, session seed 87; precise source-binding audit rather than runtime optimization. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200#discussioncomment-18991759). Current open PRs, issues, recent hub comments and cached endpoint searches showed no overlapping claim. This extends the retained file-pagination and head-binding controls; it is independent of PR3138–3140.

## Validation

`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_pr*.py' -v`

22 targeted tests pass on Python 3.14.7. The complete Python 3.12.14 research-tool suite passes **227 tests, 11 platform skips**. Controls include base-only drift with stable head/count, missing base, every-page query fields, matching/mismatching/unknown endpoint joins, no-hit warnings, unchanged old caches and failed refresh. Existing head/count/pagination/truncation controls remain.

Live API smoke checks read PR3138 (`2a4a17457e21de2de684bd8ad19938e9aef2319f`) and PR3139 (`54bbb81cc884819154776900830eeb4d9db4dc5e`) against the exact base above, yielding four and three paths respectively, neither truncated. No costly full file-index refresh or mathematical suite was needed.

## Credit and next questions

Tekalign, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Builds on Douglas Colkitt's overlap tool and the retained contributor pagination/head-binding fixes; predecessor tests and attribution remain. See `docs/research/coordination.md`. An atomic cross-request GitHub snapshot remains unavailable; consumers must still recheck live endpoints before acting.
